title: Simultaneous homotopy lift of injective SES boundaries
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $v:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive. Let $H$ be a short complex of bounded below integer cochain complexes [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. Assume every term of $H_1$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and that both the underlying sequence $S$ and its termwise $v$-image are short exact. Let $\delta_S$ and $\delta_{vS}$ be their canonical SES boundaries [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle]. There exists $f:qH_3\to(qH_1)[1]$ in $K^+(\mathcal A)$, where $q$ is the homotopy quotient, such that its localized shifted image followed by the shifted quotient-factorization comparison at $H_1$ equals the quotient-factorization comparison at $H_3$ followed by $\delta_S$. The same $f$ mapped through $v$ on $K^+$ and localized satisfies the corresponding endpoint comparison equation for $\delta_{vS}$. No right derived functor or derived unit appears.

source.place: Tags 014Q and 0152: degreewise split connecting map and its localized boundary

proof.text: Split each degree row by injectivity of the first term using ShortExact.splittingOfInjective. Construct d=homOfDegreewiseSplit and lift d to a shifted map in bounded below complexes using the inverse inclusion shift comparison. Define f by applying the bounded below homotopy quotient and its shift comparison. This is real data constructed from the given SES.

The quotient, bounded below inclusions, and quotientCompQhIso determine a shift-compatible natural isomorphism from the composite bounded below quotient/localization to the ambient localization. Apply ShiftedHom.map_naturality to d and use triangleOfSESδ_eq_degreewiseSplit to identify the source canonical boundary.

Map the degreewise splittings by v. Compute degree components using homOfDegreewiseSplit_f: the mapped connecting map followed by the shift comparison equals the connecting map for the image splittings, because v preserves composition. Apply the same split-SES boundary comparison in B and naturality of the shift-compatible quotient-factorization isomorphism to obtain the second equation.

theorem injective_ses_homotopy_boundary_lift
    {A : Type u₁} {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} A] [Abelian A]
    [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} B]
    (v : A ⥤ B) [v.Additive] (H : ShortComplex (CochainComplex.Plus A))
    [∀ n : ℤ, Injective (H.X₁.obj.X n)]
    (hH : (H.map (CochainComplex.plus A).ι).ShortExact)
    (hvH : ((H.map (CochainComplex.plus A).ι).map
      (v.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).ShortExact) :
    ∃ f : (HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient A).obj H.X₃ ⟶
        ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient A).obj H.X₁)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      ShiftedHom.map f (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι) ≫
          ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso A).hom.app H.X₁.obj)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
        (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso A).hom.app H.X₃.obj ≫
          DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ hH ∧
      ShiftedHom.map f
          ((v.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Plus.ι) ≫
          ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso B).hom.app
            ((v.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj H.X₁.obj))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
        (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso B).hom.app
            ((v.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj H.X₃.obj) ≫
          DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ hvH
